d: Our jobs aren't just about processing check-ins and check-outs. Instead, we want to create a welcoming, seamless, and memorable arrival and departure experience for every guest. Our Front Office Receptionists take the initiative to provide professional and efficient front desk services while serving as the first and last point of contact for guests throughout their stay.

Front Office Receptionists are empowered to handle a variety of responsibilities that support daily hotel operations and enhance guest satisfaction. Whether completing check-in and check-out procedures, processing payments, handling cash and credit card transactions, managing room assignments, responding to guest inquiries, resolving concerns, answering telephone calls, or coordinating with other departments, the Front Office Receptionist ensures every interaction is delivered with accuracy, professionalism, and genuine hospitality.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success: creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, safeguarding guest information, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Front Office Receptionists will be on their feet and moving around for extended periods while maintaining a highly visible presence at the front desk. Performing these responsibilities effectively, accurately handling financial transactions, and delivering exceptional guest service are essential to ensuring a positive guest experience and supporting the overall success of the hotel.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Previous experience in Front Office, Reception, Cashiering, Customer Service, Hospitality, or a related field preferred.
Proficiency in check-in and check-out procedures
Cash handling and payment processing experience
Strong customer service and guest relations skills
Excellent verbal and written communication abilities
Ability to handle guest complaints professionally and efficiently
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial transactions
Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Basic knowledge of hotel operations and reservation procedures
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, holidays, and overnight schedules as required
